subject: Board briefing: harmonize voice, slide owners, and sign-off cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Board briefing: first draft for voice alignment and owners

Team — attaching a first-pass board briefing for the Dec 8 QBR. Key asks up front:
- Review narrative voice: we need a consistent executive-to-investor tone across the first 6 slides.
- Confirm slide owners (column G in the attached signoff_matrix.csv) by EOD Monday.
- Flag any hard asks for the board (budget, hiring, major product bet).

Attachments: board_brief_v1.pptx, okr-snapshot-appendix.xlsx, signoff_matrix.csv

I kept the opener concise and moved the detailed OKR table to the appendix. If we agree on the top-line narrative, we can lock visuals and send to legal for a quick read.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategy and Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Board briefing: first draft for voice alignment and owners

Thanks, Hannah. Quick notes after a skim:
- Slide 2 (market thesis): tighten the framing on unit economics by calling out 3 metrics rather than a long paragraph. Suggest bullets: revenue/unit, latency cost per 1k tokens, and churn delta.
- OKR appendix: the growth metric for embeddings is overstated. Jonas, can you reconcile with the analytics workbook?
- Add a single slide that calls out risks and mitigations (one-liner each). Investors appreciate explicit risks.

I can own the slide with GTM progress and the risk slide. Please mark me in the signoff matrix.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Board briefing: first draft for voice alignment and owners

Hannah — thanks for starting this. A few practical edits I can pick up:
- Slide ownership: I will take slides 4 and 5 (Customer traction and Partnerships). I will swap in the Q3 cohort chart and add the customer logo mosaic.
- Visual: recommend we move the OKR heatmap out of the main flow and replace with a one-slide synthetic status (on-track / at-risk / behind). Appendix keeps the detail.
- Timing: If owners can return edits by Dec 3 COB, I will perform a visual pass on Dec 4.

A couple of micro asks: can someone add the canonical customer quote from Praxis? I think Claire offered a short blurb during the last call.

Laura Bennett
Head of Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

On the OKR numbers: I pulled the latest from analytics and updated okr-snapshot-appendix.xlsx (v1.1). Two notes:
- Embeddings growth should read 42% YoY, not 52%. I corrected the sheet and highlighted the cell in yellow.
- ARR build: I will send a short data note with assumptions (attached). Please reference the sheet when calling out ARR in the opener.

Jonas

Hannah/Laura — quick note from Praxis: the board will appreciate an explicit callout to enterprise traction and a one-sentence customer outcome. We are happy to provide a short quote you can use.

A suggested line: Redwood reduced inference latency by 3x for our latency-sensitive workflows, enabling a 20% reduction in customer cost per inference.

If you want the quote attributed to a name/title, use Claire D'Souza, Partner, Praxis Capital.

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks all — compiling a short change log and sign-off schedule. Proposed timeline:
- Dec 3 COB: owners submit content + data callouts (some owners already late; please prioritize).
- Dec 4: visual pass by Laura.
- Dec 5 morning: leadership review (Neha + Hannah) for final narrative adjustments.
- Dec 5 EOD: legal read + finalize deck for printing.
- Dec 7: final board packet assembly; Dec 8 QBR.

Please confirm if any of you need an extension. I will maintain signoff_matrix.csv and mark completed cells as I get confirmations.

Attachments: signoff_matrix.csv (updated v1.2)

Tessa Morgan
Head of Programs
Redwood Inference

All — we are on track. Final checklist:
- Laura: visuals + customer quote from Praxis (Claire has approved attribution).
- Jonas: finalize ARR assumptions note and confirm the embedding growth cell is reconciled.
- Neha: leadership review on Dec 5 morning; please call out any narrative pivots before noon.
- Tessa: lock the signoff_matrix.csv and move the deck to final folder for legal review (link below).

Final folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_board_brief
DocuSign (if needed for any one-pagers): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/DS-BOARD-2026

If no objections, I will send the packet to the board on Dec 6 AM for their read-ahead.

Thanks everyone — Hannah
